label: TP-Link TL-SF1005D
description: 5-port 10/100 desktop switch: five fast Ethernet RJ45 ports, unmanaged, plastic case.
notes: Vendor figures from the TP-Link datasheet: 5x 10/100 Mbps auto-negotiation RJ45 ports supporting auto MDI/MDIX. Unmanaged and unpowered: no PoE, no CLI, no web interface is claimed, only the L2 forwarding the hardware performs.
